Learn by doing.

We typically return only around 10 experienced members each year. That means more than half of Team 867 begins each season with little or no previous experience on the team. Rather than seeing this as a disadvantage, we make teaching part of our culture. New students first gain experience through the JPL season before joining the larger FRC build, creating a cycle where experienced students teach the next generation.
